headline_seed: Lala is again a tropical storm, sending drenching rain and winds across the Hawaiian islands - AP News
draft_text:
Tropical Storm Lala left 130,000 Hawaii customers without power and at least 1 dead Sunday, CNN and NPR report. Gov. Josh Green said 19 buildings lost roofs. Flash floods swept occupied homes off foundations near the Big Island's southern tip.

And that's the mews.
